book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: Ŋwa wù kiŋgane kifɛɛ wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ Timoti le

content: Mwɛɛ mù kuufe ye lé mu gê mu kôoshi aju a fɛkimɛsɛ le
Wo kêe lɛ, lé tô nyûme aju a kimɛsɛ le, mwɛɛ mù tɛɛme lé mu kôoshi wesee.

Bamii lé bo jâ bo kôŋe wa nyume bikwɛɛ biboo, bo koŋe bige, bo chiaase ye, bo ŋage, bo jɛme jɛ́ yì befe kune bamii bamu. Gɛ bo baaŋ bo yûge babwee baboo le bɛ bachiji baboo le gɛ, gɛ bo nyu bo nyâa lo kiyone yi fiɛɛ le gɛ, gɛ bo nyu bo kɛ̂me gee chì yuude gɛ.
Gɛ bo nyu bo kɛ̂me yii fɛ bamii le gɛ, gɛ bo nyu bo lɛ̂ɛshi tɛ bajialɛ ba bamii lɛ gɛ. Bo chɛŋe bɛ ajee a bamii, bo jiji gɛ ye yiboo le gɛ. Bo kɛme nyu gee chì kuufe ye, bo koŋe gɛ fiɛɛ fì joŋe gɛ.
Bo lé bo kâde munaŋ bamii le, bo chee kinche kì nchɛ nchɛ, bo yisɛ bɛ kinchiaasɛ ye. Bo lé bo kôŋe ki bo jii gɛh nyume bikwɛɛ biboo fede ki bo koŋe Nyo.
Bo lé bo dûunyi lɛ bo lɛme yi fiɛɛ fi Nyo le, geenɛ bo ka faŋe bvuŋga bvu fiɛɛ fi Nyo fiyu. Wo lêge lo kfuu chi bobaa bamii.
Bamii banɛ bamu jiɛnyi bo lese yéh yi bamii le bo shiide a we a bikɛse ba wɛɛyi, ba bimbefɛ biboo nyu bi yigɛ wa bo, bo tu bo njiine bo bii nyume kiŋkoŋɛ ki mwɛɛ le yeye yeye.
Bo banɛ bikɛse le ba to bo she bo yege n'yɛyɛ segechii, geenɛ taŋlo bo gɛ yu bo kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì le nchiɛɛŋ gɛ.
No Jani bɛ Jamblɛ gɛ̀ tɛɛnyi bɛ Musɛ, le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bamii banɛ tɛɛnyi nchiɛɛŋ wu Nyo. Le bamii ba bvufee bvuboo le bvu fiisɛ wa, fitele fì bo jɛme lɛ bo le bo leesɛ yi Kletu le nyu chimbiaŋ.
Geenɛ gɛ bo nyume bo ge noo gɛɛŋ bu je yì ndefe le gɛ, nje kiyuŋ kiboo lé ki bû tɛ ki chûnyɛ waaŋ fɛ bamii le bachii, gɛh no ki Jani bɛ Jamblɛ gɛ̀ bu.
Bol teefɛ Timoti lɛ wu lɛ̂me gɛh yi fiɛɛ fì bo yɛyi wu yu le

Timoti, wo le fiuŋ wo kee wa kune n'yɛyɛ waŋ bɛ kinche kaŋ mo fiɛɛ fì ŋgoone. Wo kee tɛ kune fitele fì nlese yi Nyo le bɛ shɛ́ŋ yì nto ŋkaane, mo kiŋkoŋɛ kì ŋkɛme fɛ bamii le, bɛ no nto mone yi fiɛɛ le fichii ŋgɛɛne fwe.

Wo kee tɛ bikaa bì bamii gɛ̀ boone a mɛ jiŋ mo baŋgɛ baŋ. Wo kee mwɛɛ mù gɛ̀ kooshɛ bɛ mɛ Antiok bɛ Ikoniuŋ mo Lista. Wo kee kfuu chi bikaa bì bamii gɛ̀ boone a mɛ jiŋ. Geenɛ yi baŋgɛ banɛ le bachii Tada gɛ̀ fi mɛ.
Fi le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ muh wuchii wù goone ki wu chêe kinche ki Nyo goone njɛ muh wu le wù taashɛ wa bɛ Kletu Jiso le ba nyume ba bôone bikaa a wu jiŋ.
Bamii ba ghɛge mwɛɛ bɛ bamii ba lɛɛde bamu, gee chiboo le chi foo chi gɛɛne lo, no bo lɛɛde bɛ bamii bamu bo lɛɛde tɛ bɛ bikwɛɛ biboo.
Geenɛ, fɛ wo le, wo lɛ̂me gɛh nyu yi fiɛɛ fì ba le ba yɛyɛ wo yu, wo bɛɛŋ bɛ fitele fiuŋ fichii. Wo lɛ̂me yi fi le nje wo kee bamii ba gɛ̀ yɛyɛ wo yu.
Wo gɛ̀ kɛ wo kee mwɛɛ mù ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le wo baaŋ mwa wù shige. Mwɛɛ munɛ taŋlo mu têefɛ wo, wo tô wo kɛ̂mɛ mbvusɛ yi fitele fì wo leese yi Kletu Jiso le.
Fiɛɛ fichii fì ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le, le bvufee bvuyu ja fɛ Nyo le. Fi fii ki fi yɛ̂yɛ bamii, fi chûunyi bajialɛ, fi nâji bamii, fi yɛyi bamii bɛ kinche kì chaaŋ,
wu lɛ muh wù le muh wu Nyo nyûme muh wù kojɛ, wù kɛme fiɛɛ fichii ki wu gêe lɛme chì joŋe yu chichii.
